properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7 is a declared dependency (yarn.lock:7464), pulled transitively through the elliptic/bip32/web3 ecosystem (bip32 ^2.0.5 is a direct dependency used for key derivation). It ships SHA-1/SHA-256/RIPEMD-160 implementations inside the browser bundle. No direct call site in the app's own code — presence in the shipped dependency graph is what this entry records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is a DIRECT dependency (package.json:39 "tweetnacl": "^1.0.3", also yarn.lock:13662). Its X25519 scalarMult API ships in the bundle and is exercised at runtime through the vendored ed2curve module (src/utils/diffie-hellman/ed2curve.js requires tweetnacl), which powers the extension's 'diffieHellman' method (src/pages/PopupPage.js:321).

Ships the scrypt KDF in the bundle; no scrypt call site in the app's own code. scrypt itself is quantum-safe (symmetric).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl ^1.0.3 is a direct dependency and its secretbox (XSalsa20-Poly1305) is ACTIVELY USED: src/utils/wallet-seed.js:130/176 encrypts/decrypts the wallet mnemonic+seed at rest in localStorage under a PBKDF2-SHA256 (100,000 iterations) password key, and src/utils/wallet.js:252/224 encrypts imported private keys under a BIP32/SLIP16-derived key. Quantum-safe symmetric AE (A+ rating is fair). The use-site chains are being filed as separate findings since no roster object covers those lines.
